snippet.title: PEDAL REBEL VR - EARLY ACCESS DATE - The UploadVR Showcase - Summer 2026
snippet.description: Pedal Rebel VR - Story Trailer Reveal | Early Access Announcement 5th Oct 2026. Pebel VR is a Cyberpunk Streetracing game that you can play on a real exercise bike and turn your whole body into the controller. Lean and Pedal to go fast dodge traffic, and see if you've got what it takes to join the rebellion!
